exercises.instructions: Put the words in order to make sentences. Choose the correct sentence.

questions.question:
the / never / to / cinema / go / I
Put the words in order:
options: I never go to the cinema.
Never I go to the cinema.
I go never to the cinema.
questions.answer: I never go to the cinema.
questions.explanation: 'never' goes before the main verb 'go'. 'never' ကို main verb 'go' ရှေ့မှာ ထားပါ။

Put the words in order:

Usually we don't have a break.
questions.answer: We don't usually have a break.
questions.explanation: 'usually' goes between 'don't' and the main verb 'have'. 'usually' ကို 'don't' နဲ့ 'have' ကြားမှာ ထားပါ။
